title: A tensor component is obtained from component rings of the factors
statement: For a ring $T$ and a connected component $Z$ of $\operatorname{Spec}T$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], write $T_Z=T/I_Z$, where $I_Z$ is generated by the idempotents $e$ such that $Z\subseteq V(e)$; this is the component ring. Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $B_1,B_2$ commutative $A$-algebras. For any connected component $Z$ of $\operatorname{Spec}(B_1\otimes_A B_2)$, there are connected components $Z_j$ of $\operatorname{Spec}B_j$ such that each projection maps $Z$ into $Z_j$. Put $D_j=(B_j)_{Z_j}$, $C=(B_1\otimes_A B_2)_Z$ and $E=D_1\otimes_A D_2$. The quotient $B_1\otimes_A B_2\to C$ factors through the canonical surjection $B_1\otimes_A B_2\to E$. The induced surjection $E\to C$ identifies $C$ with a component ring of $E$, compatibly with the maps from both $B_j$ and $D_j$.

source.place: Tag 00EG (lemma-connected-component), applied to both projections and to the idempotent quotient of the tensor product. This supplies the component reduction implicit in Hübner–Schmidt Theorem 6.4, printed p. 13.
